markers, or `--deselect` on the graded command each restored the historical dead-branch defect

_skip_policy: MANDATORY_TEST_SKIP_FORBIDDEN — no node in this file may rely on a skip, xfail or deselection allowance. There is currently no authorized conditional skip for any mandatory node; adding one requires an explicit `conditional_skip_policy` field and a separate justification.
_trust_boundary: This file states WHICH controls must run. scripts/pytest_session_guard.py enforces it inside
the authoritative session. The guard does not live in either protected assertion-control test
module, so deleting, ignoring or skipping those modules does not remove it.
The guard's own loading is protected three independent ways: the graded command contract

that could unload it, and tests/test_i28y_mandatory_session.py fails when the plugin is absent

mandatory_nodes.protected_invariant: every contracted load-bearing test still asserts what its authored contract requires, reachably and non-trivially
mandatory_nodes.why_mandatory: this is the only node that EXECUTES scripts/assertion_contracts.py::validate over the real registry. Gate 4N-I28X showed that de-collecting it and the layer-2 module together restores the historical dead-branch defect with a green suite.
mandatory_nodes.proving_bypass_mutation: collect_ignore of tests/test_i28u_assertion_self_protection.py together with tests/test_i28w_assertion_reachability.py, plus the historical if-False dead-branch mutation: 2902 passed / 0 failed before this guard existed

mandatory_nodes.protected_invariant: removing a load-bearing test from the authored inventory is detected
mandatory_nodes.why_mandatory: inventory completeness is one of the two blockers Gate 4N-I28V raised; without this node an entry can be dropped silently
mandatory_nodes.proving_bypass_mutation: remove a contract from the registry — caught only if this node runs

mandatory_nodes.protected_invariant: the assertion validator fails closed on problems instead of reporting clean regardless
mandatory_nodes.why_mandatory: forced-success and swallowed-failure are named I28X attacks 4 and 5; this node is what makes them visible
mandatory_nodes.proving_bypass_mutation: empty the problems list before validate() returns — 24 suite failures with this node running, none without it

mandatory_nodes.protected_invariant: an assertion that can never execute cannot satisfy its contract
mandatory_nodes.why_mandatory: this is THE pin for the Gate 4N-I28V blocker; it is the node that proves the exact historical dead-branch mutation is rejected
mandatory_nodes.proving_bypass_mutation: module-level pytestmark skip on this file plus the dead-branch mutation: 2902 passed / 0 failed / 164 skipped before this guard existed

mandatory_nodes.protected_invariant: the assertion control itself still satisfies its layer-2 meta contract
mandatory_nodes.why_mandatory: the only node that executes validate_meta over the real meta contract; without it the control can lose its own required behaviours
mandatory_nodes.proving_bypass_mutation: --deselect this node id on the graded command: zero policy problems before the command contract was hardened

mandatory_nodes.protected_invariant: the layer-2 mandatory tests are present and collectable
mandatory_nodes.why_mandatory: retained as SUPPLEMENTARY evidence. Gate 4N-I28X proved it cannot be the authority — it interrogates a separate unfiltered subprocess — but it still catches renames and repository-level addopts deselection, and it is now itself guarded.
mandatory_nodes.proving_bypass_mutation: rename a mandatory test out of its node id

mandatory_nodes.protected_invariant: the authored assertion-contract registry has not been weakened without a visible baseline change
mandatory_nodes.why_mandatory: the only node that pins registry bytes, contract count, ids, per-contract shapes and the change ledger
mandatory_nodes.proving_bypass_mutation: reduce a contract's required assertion classes — caught only if this node runs

mandatory_nodes.protected_invariant: every registered assertion helper declares third_party or in_tree provenance, and an in_tree helper pins its implementation hash
mandatory_nodes.why_mandatory: closes Gate 4N-I28W readiness criterion 16; without it a weakened in-tree helper implementation is undetectable
mandatory_nodes.proving_bypass_mutation: register an in-tree helper without an implementation_sha256

mandatory_nodes.protected_invariant: the authoritative session guard is loaded and observing THIS pytest process

mandatory_nodes.proving_bypass_mutation: run the graded command without -p pytest_session_guard

mandatory_nodes.protected_invariant: the mandatory-node registry has not been emptied, trimmed or retargeted without a visible baseline change

mandatory_nodes.proving_bypass_mutation: delete a mandatory node from this registry, or replace the registry with the current collection

mandatory_nodes.protected_invariant: the object holding the guard's plugin name is the genuine MandatorySessionGuard, with pinned implementation provenance and evidence that its lifecycle hooks actually executed
